feature_contract.goal: For the complete stencil read-only stereo draw path, eliminate redundant per-draw depth-surface format driver queries after a generation-fenced R29 no-write policy while preserving active stencil writes and all missing-cache/device-reset conservative paths.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R29 game-side stencil read-only depth-surface format queries only. No R30 buffer registry, HUD/menu placement, eye pose, host copy, DX11, DXVK, quality presets or FFB changes.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: R29OwnerLeftDrawMayWriteStencil previously invokes SurfaceHasStencil(TrackedDepthStencil) for every stencil-enabled stereo draw even when R29StencilWriteCacheCurrent() already guarantees mayWrite=false. The live surface format COM GetDesc is unnecessary for a provably nonwriting draw; Quest3 scene-matched savings are unmeasured.
trace_stages: D3D9 game SetRenderState stencil enable, write mask and operations are tracked by R29 setter and StateBlock generation fences.
R29OwnerLeftDrawMayWriteStencil drives stereo main depth/stencil write accounting before R30/R33 per-eye rendering.
OpenXR host receives unchanged left/right surfaces and depth with fewer game-side live D3D9 GetDesc calls on read-only stencil draws.
subcomponents: Fast-negative generation/epoch fenced stencil no-write route bypasses depth surface format driver query and retains the same returned write decision.

Writable stencil, stale StateBlock generations, resets, missing surface and live-read failures continue original format and lower fallback behavior; source mutation/model checker rejects unsafe bypass.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: For each current read-only stencil snapshot, classify no-write without additional per-draw depth format GetDesc; all 4, 16 and 32:9 mode timing effects are left unclaimed until hardware measurement.

Writable mask/operations, expired Present/StateBlock snapshots, stale setters and missing formats follow the original SurfaceHasStencil and lower reader; destructive no-write predicate/fence mutations must be detected.
Pass same exact result-SHA DX9Ex Active five jobs and Domain Isolation; full source impact when workflow applies. Quest3 frame time and optics are explicitly untested.

diagnosis.original_evidence: At R29 current HEAD, the depth-surface format check precedes the available generation-fenced no-write predicate in every stencil-enabled Draw.
diagnosis.root_cause: The function always runs SurfaceHasStencil, a live COM format query, before considering a previously proven no-write policy for the same Present and StateBlock generation.
source_trace: R29 stencil state setter updates generation-coherent write policy.
R29 stereo draw uses R29OwnerLeftDrawMayWriteStencil to decide depth/stencil writes.
OpenXR host composes the produced per-eye unchanged render targets.
alternatives_rejected: No global stencil-format memo across Release/Reset due COM pointer reuse risk.
No skipping positive format checks or stencil writes.
No unmeasured Quest3 FPS gains inferred from source-call reductions.
